name: 投稿者と時刻付きのステッカーメッセージ
prompt:
Create a single, clean landscape mobile component screenshot matching the attached Japanese native preview at exactly 390 × 236 px. Use the native preview as the exact ground truth for layout, Japanese wording, scale and Lighthouse colors. Use the original screenshot crop to confirm the message/sticker context, and preserve the attached original sticker artwork exactly rather than redrawing it. Show only this component on flat white, with no device frame, no card background and no extra interface.

Match these native positions: the 36×36 circular mint avatar at x=16,y=10 with centered 「佐」 in Meiryo Bold 14 px #064E3B; sender 「佐藤 ゆう」 at x=68,y=8 in Meiryo Bold 14 px #1D1D1D; the pale-mint rounded group chip x=166,y=10,w=68,h=32 with centered 「交流会」 in Meiryo Regular 12 px #064E3B; and right-aligned time 「20:41」 at x=280,y=12,w=94,h=16 in Meiryo Regular 12 px #6E6E6E. Keep the message itself white and unboxed.

Place the exact original blue robot and floating lime-green leaf sticker art in the white image region x=68,y=56,w=154,h=166. Preserve its original proportions, black outlines, blue body, light face, facial marks, raised arm, leaf, and small gray ground shadow. Do not add or remove any sticker detail. Preserve the Japanese placeholder avatar rather than the source screenshot portrait. Do not copy the source screenshot's English name, pink badge or English time.

There is no hyperlink in this component: the sender is bold dark text, the chip label is forest green, and the time is gray, all without underline. If an actual hyperlink is visible, color only that link text blue #1976D2. Do not turn ordinary names, chip labels, times, or controls blue. Do not add English copy, other icons, bubbles, buttons, decoration or gradients.
reviewNotes: Matches native 390x236 structure, Japanese text, mint avatar/chip, gray time and blue robot/green leaf art. Overlay/diff inspected; small residuals: sender slightly tighter, time about 4px right, minor sticker linework/body proportion differences. No semantic hyperlink exists, so no blue text. Source portrait remains replaced by native initial avatar.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
